+"""
+Loads image bytes from a reference that a user may have set (cut image_path,
+character profile image, style reference, ...).
+
+The backend never makes a network request to an address taken from user
+input. Only two kinds of reference are accepted:
+
+- ``data:`` URLs, decoded in memory;
+- objects in our own storage, given either as a storage key
+  (``episodes/<id>/<uuid>.png``) or as a URL under ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``.
+  These are read through the storage client, not over HTTP.
+
+Every other URL (any other host, scheme, or address) is refused.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import logging
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def _storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage key for `ref`, or None if `ref` is not in our storage."""
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if "://" in ref or ref.startswith("//"):
+        if not host or not ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+            return None
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    else:
+        # Any other scheme-like prefix (e.g. "file:", "gopher:") is refused.
+        if ":" in ref.split("/", 1)[0]:
+            return None
+        key = ref
+    key = urlsplit(key).path if ("?" in key or "#" in key) else key
+    key = unquote(key).lstrip("/")
+    if not key or "\\" in key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return key
+
+
+def is_allowed_image_ref(ref: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+    """True if `ref` is a data: URL or an object in our storage."""
+    if not ref:
+        return False
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        return True
+    return _storage_key(ref) is not None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the bytes `ref` points to, or None if it is empty, refused, or missing."""
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:"):
+        try:
+            _, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+            logger.warning("Invalid data: URL image reference")
+            return None
+    key = _storage_key(ref)
+    if key is None:
+        logger.warning("Refused to load image from a URL outside our storage")
+        return None
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+"""Exports report the cuts they leave out: `missing.txt` in the ZIP and the
+`X-Missing-Cuts` header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _store(key, data=PNG):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    storage.client.objects.setdefault(settings.MINIO_BUCKET, {})[key] = data
+    return key
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry, numbered 1.."""
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    ).json()
+    for n, path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/cuts",
+            headers=h,
+            json={"episode_id": ep["id"], "cut_order": n, "image_path": path},
+        )
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return ep["id"]
+
+
+MIXED = [
+    "storage-ok",                                   # 1 included
+    None,                                           # 2 no image yet
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",     # 3 refused address
+    "episodes/test/does-not-exist.png",             # 4 not in storage
+    "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"not an image").decode(),  # 5 unloadable
+    "data-ok",                                      # 6 included
+]
+
+
+def _mixed_paths():
+    data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+    return [_store("episodes/test/ok.png") if p == "storage-ok" else data_url if p == "data-ok" else p for p in MIXED]
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, _mixed_paths())
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,5"
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert sorted(zf.namelist()) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_06.png", "missing.txt"]
+    assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode().splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4", "5"]
+
+
+def test_webtoon_reports_missing_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, _mixed_paths())
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG")
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,5"
+
+
+def test_zip_without_missing_cuts_has_no_list_or_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [_store("episodes/test/a.png"), _store("episodes/test/b.png")])
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    zf = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
+    assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+    assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+
+def test_webtoon_without_missing_cuts_has_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [_store("episodes/test/a.png")])
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+
+
+def test_header_is_exposed_to_browsers(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _episode(client, h, [_store("episodes/test/a.png"), None])
+
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip",
+        headers={**h, "Origin": "http://localhost:3000"},
+    )
+
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" in r.headers["Access-Control-Expose-Headers"].lower()

+"""The backend must never request an image URL a user can set; only data:

+import base64

+import zipfile

+import pytest

+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG

+INTERNAL_URLS = [

+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    """Fails the test if anything opens a network connection or calls requests."""
+    calls = []
+
+    def refuse(*args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(args)
+        raise AssertionError(f"network access attempted: {args!r}")
+
+    import requests
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests, "get", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", refuse)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", refuse)
+    return calls
+

+def _store(key, data=PNG):
+    from app.core.config import settings

+        "/api/v1/episodes",

+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project["id"], "episode_order": 1},

+        json={"episode_id": ep.json()["id"], "cut_order": 1, "image_path": image_path},

+/**
+ * Reads the cut numbers an episode export left out, from its
+ * `X-Missing-Cuts` header ("2,3,5"). Returns them joined as "2, 3, 5",
+ * or null when the export left nothing out.
+ */
+export function getMissingCuts(headers: unknown): string | null {
+  if (!headers || typeof headers !== 'object') return null;
+  const h = headers as { get?: (name: string) => unknown } & Record<string, unknown>;
+  const raw = typeof h.get === 'function' ? h.get('x-missing-cuts') : h['x-missing-cuts'];
+  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return null;
+  const cuts = raw.split(',').map((n) => n.trim()).filter(Boolean);
+  return cuts.length ? cuts.join(', ') : null;
+}
